rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that makes someone lose face or feel humiliated.

example.english: Being scolded in front of so many people is really degrading.
example.traditional: 喺咁多人面前畀人鬧，真係好丟架。
example.jyutping: hai2 gam3 do1 jan4 min6 cin4 bei2 jan4 naau6 zan1 hai6 hou2 diu1 gaa2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on an embarrassing or humiliating situation that is hard to endure.

example.english: Having to sing in front of the whole class is quite degrading.
example.traditional: 要我喺全班面前唱歌，真係幾難堪。
example.jyutping: jiu3 ngo5 hai2 cyun4 baan1 min6 cin4 coeng3 go1 zan1 hai6 gei2 naan4 ham1

rows.note: Use this for conduct or treatment that is explicitly insulting or degrading to someone's dignity.

example.english: This degrading treatment completely disregards the patient's dignity.
example.traditional: 呢種侮辱性對待，完全無視病人尊嚴。
example.jyutping: ne1 zung2 mou5 juk6 sing3 deoi3 doi6 jyun4 cyun4 mou4 si6 beng6 jan4 zyun1 jim4
